component.name: Reolink Linux Client
component.summary: Native Linux client for Reolink cameras and NVRs

description.p: A fully native Linux desktop client for Reolink cameras and NVRs — a 1:1 replica of the official Reolink Client. Live grid (1/4/9/16) with hardware-accelerated H.264/H.265 decode, double-click maximize and fullscreen, PTZ, snapshots, manual recording, a color-coded playback timeline, an events inbox, and the full device-settings surface.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Reolink.

Fixes HD streaming on cameras whose firmware doesn't report the main-stream codec (the stream is now probed instead of assumed), fixes false 90-degree rotation of hub-attached cameras, and adds a persisted per-camera Rotate View override.

Synced 4-camera playback on one timeline with per-camera coverage lanes, drag-and-drop camera arrangement in both live view and playback, double-click maximize with an HD toggle, digital zoom in playback panes, honest device error states with automatic recovery for unreachable devices, credential repair from the sidebar, and pre-validated Add Device with inline errors.

Launching the app again now raises the running window instead of starting a second copy, so tray icons no longer pile up. Hardware video decoding works on hosts with VAAPI, cutting CPU use during live view.

System tray with background monitoring, camera offline alerts, event thumbnails and per-camera filtering, detection markers on the playback timeline, clip export, and a weekly recording-schedule editor.
Clicking a detection notification now opens the app and plays that event back; the app version is shown in the nav bar.
The AppImage now runs natively on Wayland (bundles the Qt Wayland platform plugins) instead of falling back to XWayland.
Detection-zone editor, 6-camera live grid, desktop notifications, a nested device tree with icons, event retention cap, and a built-in update checker.
Initial development release: live view, playback, events, and settings.
